GET /api.description: Serves a JSON representation of all available API endpoints. This documentation endpoint is public; application endpoints require an authenticated session except registration, login, and logout. For an existing database, run npm run migrate:auth to create the session table without reseeding data.

GET /api/reports/:report_type/data.description: Generates JSON report data for a supported report type. Provide period_start and period_end as YYYY-MM-DD query parameters.

report.summary: Vulnerability identification and remediation summary for the reporting period.
report.narrative: Prioritise remediation of critical and high-severity findings.
limitations: Overdue vulnerabilities cannot be calculated because the vulnerability schema has no due-date field.

GET /api/reports/:report_type/pdf.description: Generates a PDF for a supported report type and displays it inline in the browser. Use management_summary to combine metrics from all five report types. Provide period_start and period_end as YYYY-MM-DD query parameters.

GET /api/dashboard/summary.description: Returns current key metrics across vulnerabilities, vendor risks, projects, threat intelligence and recorded activity. Period metrics default to the last 30 days; optional period_start and period_end query parameters override the range. Threat trends default to the last six calendar months.

GET /api/dashboard/threat-intelligence.description: Returns threat article metrics and monthly collection trends grouped by severity. Period metrics default to the last 30 days; threat trends default to the last six calendar months. Optional period_start and period_end query parameters set both ranges.

GET /api/dashboard/vulnerabilities.description: Returns current open vulnerability counts and severity breakdown, plus identified and remediated counts for the last 30 days by default. Optional period_start and period_end query parameters override the activity period.

GET /api/dashboard/vendor-risks.description: Returns current vendor risk counts and risk-level breakdown, plus created and closed counts for the last 30 days by default. Optional period_start and period_end query parameters override the activity period.

GET /api/dashboard/projects.description: Returns current project status counts and recorded project update/status-change activity for the last 30 days by default. Optional period_start and period_end query parameters override the activity period.

GET /api/dashboard/activity.description: Returns audit and status-change counts for the last 30 days by default, plus the 20 most recent audit actions and 20 most recent status changes. Optional period_start and period_end query parameters set the count period.

POST /api/auth/register.description: Creates an account using a scrypt password hash and immediately starts an eight-hour HttpOnly session. Registration is public.

POST /api/auth/login.description: Authenticates credentials and starts an eight-hour HttpOnly session cookie.

POST /api/auth/logout.description: Revokes the current session and clears its cookie.

GET /api/auth/me.description: Returns the authenticated user's safe profile fields.

PATCH /api/auth/password.description: Changes the authenticated user's password after verifying the current password. Revokes all sessions, requiring a new login.

GET /api/users.description: Lists safe user profile fields. Requires authentication; password hashes are never returned.

GET /api/users/:id.description: Returns one user's safe profile fields. Requires authentication.

PATCH /api/users/:id.description: Updates the authenticated user's username. Only the account owner may update their own profile; password changes use PATCH /api/auth/password.

GET /api/vulnerabilities/:vulnerability_.description: Serves a single vulnerability identified by its ID.

PATCH /api/vulnerabilities/:vulnerabilit.description: Updates an existing vulnerability by its ID.
Updates the status of an existing vulnerability by its ID.

DELETE /api/vulnerabilities/:vulnerabili.description: Deletes a vulnerability identified by its ID.

GET /api/relationships/:record_relations.description: Serves a single relationship identified by its record_relationship_id.

POST /api/relationships.description: Creates a relationship linking two records.

DELETE /api/relationships/:record_relati.description: Deletes a relationship identified by its record_relationship_id without deleting the linked records.

GET /api/records/:record_type/:relations.description: Serves all relationships where the specified record is either the source or target. The record type and record ID are supplied as route parameters.

GET /api/status-history.description: Serves status history entries across all tracked records.

GET /api/records/:record_type/:relations.description: Serves status history for the specified record type and record ID.

GET /api/audit-logs.description: Serves audit log entries across the system, newest first. Optional filters: record_type, record_id, action, user_id, from, to (YYYY-MM-DD) and limit.

audit_log.details: Project status changed from not_started to in_progress.

GET /api/audit-logs/:audit_log_id.description: Serves a single audit log entry identified by its ID.

audit_log.details: Project status changed from not_started to in_progress.

GET /api/vulnerabilities/:vulnerability_.description: Lists the timestamped notes recorded directly on a vulnerability, newest first.

POST /api/vulnerabilities/:vulnerability.description: Adds a timestamped note to a vulnerability. The author is the signed-in user.

exampleRequest.body: Patch scheduled for the next maintenance window.

POST /api/vulnerability-imports/:vulnera.description: Approves staged import findings, creating vulnerabilities (or attaching assets to existing ones) without duplicating records.
Discards a staged import so none of its findings are added to the vulnerability list.

GET /api/records/lookup/:record_type.description: Lists records of one type (vulnerability, vendor, vendor_risk or project) in a compact form, for choosing a link target.

GET /api/records/:record_type/:relations.description: Lists the records linked to a record, with the relationship type and direction from that record's point of view.

POST /api/reports/:report_type/data.description: Same as the GET version, but accepts period_start, period_end, title and narrative in a JSON body.

POST /api/reports/:report_type/pdf.description: Generates a chart-based PDF report (management_summary, vulnerability_summary, vendor_risk or project_status). Accepts period_start, period_end, title and narrative in a JSON body. The management summary also includes saved SOC, phishing and ticket inputs for the period.

GET /api/reports/:report_type/docx.description: Generates a Word (.docx) version of the report. Query parameters are period_start and period_end.

POST /api/reports/:report_type/docx.description: Generates a Word (.docx) report from a JSON body with period_start, period_end, title and narrative.

GET /api/report-inputs.description: Returns the manually entered report inputs saved for a period: SOC report, phishing campaign results and monthly cyber security ticket statistics. Provide period_start and period_end.

PUT /api/report-inputs/soc.description: Saves the SOC report text and optional screenshot for a period (multipart form: period_start, period_end, summary, screenshot, remove_screenshot). Screenshots must be PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 5 MB.

GET /api/report-inputs/soc/screenshot.description: Returns the saved SOC screenshot (PNG) for a period, or 404 if none is saved.

PUT /api/report-inputs/phishing.description: Replaces the phishing campaign results for a period.

PUT /api/report-inputs/tickets.description: Saves the total tickets opened and per-category ticket counts for one month. Blank category values are removed.

GET /api/dashboard/:dashboard_type.description: Dashboard data for a period. dashboard_type is one of summary, vulnerabilities, vendor-risks, projects, activity or threat-intelligence. Provide period_start and period_end.
